item.title: Upbeat Reel Music Default

turns.text: Can you make me some music? Something upbeat for a reel.

item.tests: Checks whether the agent turns a vague music request into a usable upbeat audio bed using sensible defaults rather than blocking on optional preferences.

answer_sheet.Use and platform: Background music for a short social reel; the specific platform is your call.
answer_sheet.Output: One standalone music audio file, not a video.

must_haves: One playable music audio file is delivered, not merely a description or song recommendation.
The music sounds upbeat, with a clear rhythmic pulse and lively energy.
The opening establishes the music promptly without a long silent lead-in.
The short excerpt is usable as a reel music bed, without audible glitches or an abrupt mid-note cutoff.
changed: 2026-11-01: test fix from the careful review (F30b: the user left the length open; D18c: the photo is 5:3, not 16:9)

turns.text: Can you make me some music? Something upbeat for a reel. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what it will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter, or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
Yes—an upbeat instrumental would work well for a reel.

**Music generation costs 1 credit per requested second:**

| Length | Cost |
|---|---:|
| 15 seconds—the minimum | **15 credits** |
| 30 seconds | 30 credits |
| 60 seconds | 60 credits |

**The cheapest option is one 15-second track.** There’s no smaller-file or lower-quality setting that reduces the cost, and instrumental-only costs the same as music with vocals. Trimming a longer track afterward won’t reduce its generation cost.

I suggest **15 seconds of bright, bouncy instrumental pop with a punchy beat and an immediate hook**.

**Nothing has run or spent credits.** Would you like me to proceed for **15 credits**, provided your free account has enough available?

turns.agent:
Your account refused the **15-credit** request because there aren’t enough credits available. **No music was generated and no credits were spent.**

A 15-second track is the cheapest supported option, so I can’t reduce the cost further in Magic Hour. A free alternative is to use an upbeat instrumental from your reel app’s music library—check that it’s licensed for your intended use.

approvals.name: generate_music

style.prompt: Bright, upbeat, bouncy instrumental pop for a social media reel. Immediate catchy hook from the first beat, punchy danceable drums, buoyant bass, sparkling synths and cheerful rhythmic guitar. Energetic, feel-good, polished and modern, around 120 BPM. No vocals. Keep a consistent groove and finish with a clean ending suitable for looping.
